candidates.speaker: Christopher Hitchens

candidates.speaker: Christopher Hitchens

candidates.contextSummary: After grounding secular meaning in solidarity and useful action, Hitchens broadens the account to include aesthetic and emotional experience, friendship, discussion, and willingness to test one's worldview.

candidates.speaker: Christopher Hitchens
